player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee leek {player_id} ee duël ee {num_rounds}-duël ëë IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Këë ee duël, gɛ̈ɛ̈m akɔ̈ɔ̈n kɛ̈ɛ̈m {min_guess} ku {max_guess}.
Këë ee gɛ̈ɛ̈m ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n, akɔ̈ɔ̈n ee rot looi ee (2/3)x(akɔ̈ɔ̈n ee gɛ̈ɛ̈m ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n),
ku leek ee gɛ̈ɛ̈m ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee rot looi ee duël.
Dhɔ̈ɔ̈ ee gɛ̈ɛ̈m ee yɔ̈ɔ̈n ee '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Acie path; ku yïn alëu ba wɛ̈tdu bɛ̈n lɛ̈k kɔc ë [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Guess adhil tɔ̈u në kaam de {min_guess} ku {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Leek 0 ee gɛ̈ɛ̈m ee {guess0}; Leek 1 ee gɛ̈ɛ̈m ee {guess1}. Këë ee rot looi ee: {target}.
message.round_draw: Thëm ee kë ye kɔc thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ.
message.round_win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {winner} ee cï tɔŋ bɛ̈n tiaam!

outcome.p0_wins: Raan ye 0 ke yen acï wëu juëc bɛ̈n yök.
outcome.p1_wins: Raan ye 1 acï wëu juëc bɛ̈n tiaam.
outcome.draw: Në ye mɛn, ke kɔc acï bɛ̈n mat.
